location.mapTitle: Map showing SSquare Sports Arena, Nadiad

hours.a: SSquare is open 24 hours, all 7 days. You can book any time — early morning, afternoon or late night.

book.q: How do I book a slot?
book.a: Check free slots on this page, then tap a free time to send us a WhatsApp message or call us. Your booking is confirmed when our team replies.

duration.q: Can I book for 1½ hours or more?
duration.a: Yes. You can book for 1 hour, 1½ hours, 2 hours or longer, as long as the time is free.

pickleball.q: I have never played pickleball. Can I still come?
pickleball.a: Of course! Pickleball is easy to learn and fun for all ages. Ask us and we will be happy to guide you.

sports.q: Which sports can be played on the turf?
sports.a: The turf is used for box cricket and football. One group can book it at a time.

payment.a: You can pay by UPI or cash. For some times, a small advance may be needed to confirm the booking.

cancel.q: What if I need to cancel?
cancel.a: Please inform us as early as possible on call or WhatsApp so the time can be given to others.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: We are happy to help. Call or WhatsApp any time.

pickleball.intro: SSquare has the only synthetic pickleball court in Nadiad. The surface gives good grip and a true bounce, and the court is marked with proper lines. Whether you are new to pickleball or play regularly, you will enjoy every game here.
points: Friendly place for families and beginners
pickleball.what: Pickleball is a paddle sport that mixes parts of tennis, badminton and table tennis. It is easy to learn, gentle on the body and great fun for all ages — that is why it is becoming popular across India.

turf.h1: Box cricket & football turf in Nadiad

points: Box cricket and football on the same turf
turf.what: Choose a free time below, tell us how long you want to play (1 hour, 1½ hours or more), and send a WhatsApp message. Our team will confirm your booking.
